This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.13/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of DP Act, registered at PS Karawal Nagar, New Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 27.11.2020 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
No issue was born from the wedlock.

However, because of marital discord the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 started residing separately and at the instance of respondent no.2 the present FIR was registered.
3. Due to intervention of family members and friends the parties have settled their disputes and in lieu of said settlement the petitioner no.1 agreed to pay an amount of Rs.3.00 lacs to the respondent no.2 towards all her claims including permanent alimony, maintenance (present, past and future),
stridhan etc.

It is submitted an amount of Rs.2.00 lacs has already been paid and the balance amount of Rs.1.00 lac has been paid today through demand draft dated 22.03.2023 bearing no.020598 drawn on by IDBI Bank.
The parties have already obtained divorce by mutual consent.

sentences.text: The complainant/respondent No.2 is present today and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed as the matter is settled and she has received the entire settled amount from the petitioners and she has left with no claim against them.
The learned ASC for the State has also no objection, if this petition is allowed.
The affidavits of parties are on record.
5. In view of the above, there is no impediment in quashing of present FIR as the matter is settled and it would never entail in conviction of the petitioners herein.
6. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.13/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of DP Act, registered at PS Karawal Nagar, New Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom stands quashed.
Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
